Pay the application fee online, if applicable.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MPSC Bench Clerk Grade-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the MPSC Bench Clerk Grade-II recruitment is 21st August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Bench Clerk Grade-II post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Bench Clerk Grade-II position by the Mizoram Public Service Commission (MPSC) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Bench Clerk Grade-II post, candidates must have completed at least 3 years of regular service in the cadre of Bench Clerk Grade-III.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Bench Clerk Grade-II position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Bench Clerk Grade-II post will receive a salary as per Level 6 in the Pay Matrix, as determined by the Mizoram Public Service Commission.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the MPSC Bench Clerk Grade-II recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official MPSC website.

faq.question: Q6. What are the selection criteria for the Bench Clerk Grade-II role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Bench Clerk Grade-II position involves a Limited Departmental Examination followed by a Written Examination.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the MPSC Bench Clerk Grade-II application?
faq.answer: As per the notification, there is no application fee mentioned for the PwBD category. Other categories should refer to the official notification for fee details.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF for the MPSC Bench Clerk Grade-II recruitment can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, where a direct link is provided.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of the Mizoram Public Service Commission?
faq.answer: The official website of the Mizoram Public Service Commission (MPSC) is mpsconline.mizoram.gov.in. You can visit this site for more information and to apply.

faq.question: Q10. What is the date of the examination for the Bench Clerk Grade-II post?
faq.answer: The examination for the Bench Clerk Grade-II post is scheduled to be conducted on 14th September 2026. Candidates should prepare accordingly.
